_comment: Per-MODULE champion registry for the Ladrillo benchmark. Promotion is manual and
'tag' must have a frozen snapshot under benchmark/reference/<tag>/.
Champions are per module because a change that improves one module and leaves the
others untouched should not silently take credit for them.

ais.why: L24 is the only vintage on the SHIPPED prior N(1.09, 0.180) (165a860). On fit it is indistinguishable from L23 -- 85/65/6 vs 86/64/6, and only 3 of 304 cells change verdict for a 1.8x wider prior -- so the tiebreaker is provenance, not skill. Promoted 2026-09-02 on a CORRECTED basis: L23's promotion reasoning (the glacier law moving AIS@2300 by +66 cm) is VOID, and the cause was a dropped --amp-mu=0.95, not the law. See champions.json prior_promotion_2026-09-01 and notes/note_2026-09-01_vintage_comparison_L21_L23_L24_L25.md.
ais.prior_promotion_2026-09-01: L23, promoted 2026-09-01, SUPERSEDED by L24 on 2026-09-02. Kept because the reasoning is part of the record and because its retraction is the reason this registry now carries one. ORIGINAL why: Floored glacier equilibrium + bounded regrowth replaces an unphysical melt-only ratchet (Marcus 2026-08-31). Adopts the position that the ratchet was manufacturing the old AIS amplification constraint: a 2x2 (L21/L22/L23/L23b) shows the law moves ais_gmst_amp 1.43 prior sd and AIS@2300 by 66 cm, against 4.93 cm between-refit reproducibility. Promoted 2026-09-01 with that attribution explicit and the identifiability question open.  || CORRECTION: REFUTED 2026-09-01, the same day, and the `why` above is KEPT VERBATIM as the record of what was decided on what evidence. Two measurements retire its mechanism. (1) The glacier law is INERT in the calibration likelihood: old vs new differ by <=7.3e-05 in log-likelihood on L23-region draws, against 1.86 for a 1% wiggle of one glacier parameter and 11.4 for 1% of amp -- a null WITH power (scope_amp ... || RESOLUTION: RESOLVED 2026-09-01 (later still), by L25. L25 = L23's configuration with L21/L22's proposal covariance; it reads ais_gmst_amp = 1.0791 +/- 0.0030, which is 0.7 se from L23 and 39 se from L21 -- so the COVARIANCE is exonerated too, and with the likelihood route already dead (a null WITH power) both standing hypotheses failed. THE CAUSE IS A THIRD DROPPED FLAG. run_mcmc_L21.sh and run_mcmc_L22.sh p ...
